conflictOfInterest.details: Founding-stage isolation check: the accountable principal VSBDev operates the authoring, review, and finalization agents, so principal-level independence is absent. Agent-level role isolation was strictly maintained: no authoring history, other review output, or adjudication draft was read, and no other EmbeddedKnowledge role script was run during this review execution.

findings.finding: The worked example in Scene 2 is exceptionally well structured, fully adhering to all 9-part requirements of Section 5.1 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md. It models geometric cylinders and spheres, presents clear plans, explicit calculations with units, diffusion scaling checks, physical interpretations, and a self-explanation prompt asking students to reflect on the core decision of fixing the diffusion coefficient.

Misconception repair and epistemics. Scene 4 handles the common student misconception of prokaryotes being 'primitive first drafts' or 'simpler' with high pedagogical skill. It states the incorrect model neutrally, provides three categories of counterexamples (phylogenomic placement, prokaryotic organelles, and giant bacteria outliers), compares them on the same case, and uses a retrieval check to consolidate the repaired framework, matching Section 7 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md.

Scaffolded practice progression. Scene 5 implements an excellent 4-pass practice progression that moves from a complete model to a completion problem, a supported engineering prompt, and independent conceptual explanation. This progression perfectly matches the scaffolding requirements of Section 6 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md.

Accessibility and alternative modalities. The dedicated 'Accessibility and alternatives' section in Scene 7 provides exemplary descriptions of the alternative formats available for all tasks, calculations, and visuals (including equivalent text descriptions for the cell drawing, line chart, and flow diagram), aligning with Section 11 of CONTENT-STANDARD.md.

Constructive alignment. The assessment items in assessment.json show direct and robust alignment with the outcome and objectives. The open-response questions (item-explain-size-consequences, item-envelope-tradeoff, item-generation-time-account, item-antibiotic-selectivity-transfer) require active application of the conceptual models, featuring detailed rubrics with point allocations, clear reasoning, common errors, and defined retry variations.

limitations: Expert-simulation review: This review represents a single-pass advisory input by a simulated learning-design expert under standard-lesson-v3 guidelines. No real learner testing was conducted.
Conflict of interest: The same GitHub principal (VSBDev) is responsible for the authoring and review run operators. Agent-level isolation was maintained, but principal-level independence is absent.

Scope restriction: The review is strictly bounded to learning-design metrics (e.g. clarity, coherence, practice, alignment, and transfer). Scientific accuracy, rights audits, and final typesetting checks are excluded.

Technical verification limits: No rendered build environment, screen reader, or keyboard navigation pathways were evaluated physically; findings are based solely on the static Markdown and JSON source files.
